value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Upland/San Bernardino County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: The page states 'City permit approval is still required' regardless of pathway (SolarAPP+ or the CSS Portal), but does not enumerate specific required documents.

value: Call the Inspection Voicemail Line at (909) 931-4129 by 4:00pm the business day prior, providing project address, permit number, inspection type, AM/PM request, and contact info
Have the permit card and approved permit plans (downloadable via the CSS Portal) available at the job site
Inspections are conducted Monday-Thursday; to verify your inspection, call (909) 931-4110 the morning of the scheduled date
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building & Safety inspection scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (single-family/duplex, under 38.4 kW) / CSS Portal (all other submissions)
other_conditions: Single-family and duplex PV systems under 38.4 kW are eligible for SolarAPP+
Battery/energy storage systems may be included in a SolarAPP+ submission
